folder_levels.comment: structure folder written by tools/run_all_workloads.py: a bare structure (btree, wtree, std) or structure-version (wtree-simple, wtree-split)
node-size variant folder, or 'default' for a structure without a node-size knob (std::map)

line_schema.comment: one headerless series row per (phase, operation) with time and memory merged; the last three columns are the structure's own metrics, absent (null) for structures that report none. ragged=true because btree/wtree rows carry those three extra fields and std::map rows do not, in the same tree.
